contract.description: Report store health: active, superseded and tombstoned counts, records per scope, idempotencyConflicts and the gc heartbeat, where stale=true means the sweep is overdue and expired records may be piling up; pendingCompaction is the whole-store compaction backlog across all tomes while memory_brief.compactionDue scopes the briefed tome; byTome splits active and tombstoned per tome while counts span the whole store. Opt into pendingCompactionByTome when you need the backlog split per tome - it plans every tome's journal and costs extra, so it is skipped by default. Call it after a failed memory call to check reachability, or to size the compaction loop before working candidates.
